description: Parameter schema, schema confidence, and exampleCall for one SKU. total_cost is the all-in price only. Default USD. If the record is untested and totalSats is over 500, tell the user before buying. When Lightning payments are temporarily paused, the result includes paymentsPaused and retryAfter.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the fiat estimate. Default USD. Use the user's local currency when you know it. Supported: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, CHF, BRL, MXN, INR.

quantity.description: How many calls to price. Default 1, maximum 3.

sku.description: Catalog id or slug from search_catalog.

name: describe_sku

outputSchema.description: The same object as the text JSON. code is set when the call stopped before delivery.

approvalUrl.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

results.description: Search rows when this is a search result.

which.description: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.

title: Describe SKU
